sentences.text: Alistipes dispar was proposed for strain 5CPEGH6T, one of three groups of Gram-stain-negative, obligately anaerobic bacteria isolated from faecal samples of healthy Japanese humans, related to Alistipes shahii.
The genus Alistipes is assigned to the family Rikenellaceae in the phylum Bacteroidetes.

A mouse study reported that modified citrus pectin enriched Alistipes dispar, and that live but not heat-killed cells reproduced its protective effects in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease models.
